主要内容: The document titled 'f2211206k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, published on February 22, 2012. It outlines the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, including Redeemable Step Up Notes due on February 22, 2028, and Reverse Convertible Notes linked to Chesapeake Energy Corporation's common stock. The filing includes details about the pricing and settlement dates, with the principal amounts totaling $2,600,000 and $2,025,000 respectively. The document also references legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The filing is part of the Bank's shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806).
